title: UPME (Colombia) confirmed as a PLEXOS direct user
description: Colombia's national energy planning unit's own 2020-2034 expansion plan states it acquired PLEXOS v8.2 — reversing 4 prior independent negative searches.

title: GRIDCo (Ghana Grid Company Limited) added
description: Found via a World Bank procurement contract-award record, distinct from the existing Ghana Energy Commission entry.

title: OCCTO (Japan) reversed from rejected to confirmed
description: OCCTO's own committee materials (2018–2025) describing a multi-year internal PLEXOS-based evaluation outweighed the earlier data-source-only rejection.

title: Tetra Tech / Turkmenistan entry removed
description: Downgraded and removed after a second-pass evidence review found the original source didn't name Turkmenistan specifically.

title: NEXT Group (South Korea) role corrected
description: Changed from consultant_modeler to research_user to reflect its actual co-equal research role in the engagement.

title: 62 new organizations added in a global expansion pass
description: PJM, MISO, NESO (UK), TenneT, KPX, Eskom, and dozens more confirmed across North America, Europe, Asia, and Africa/Middle East.

title: New "subject of study" use cases added
description: GECOL (Libya), Sudan Electricity Holding Company, and EMS (Serbia) added as organizations passively modeled in someone else's PLEXOS study, not direct users themselves.

title: Tracked country coverage expanded to 200 countries
description: Grew from 163 to the full 200-country world list, surfacing gaps in Central Africa, the Pacific, and Caribbean microstates.
